title: 1637 Prairie's carved south bay rises on its side wall
items: The Spalding house on Prairie Avenue now has the stone bay its oldest photograph shows on its south side: a tall arched window, a bracketed cornice and a balustrade on top, with an arched window over it in the wall above.
The bay keeps its 1911 fire-insurance-map outline and the photograph's heights. Its columns, carving and side windows come next.
